name: Article 15, § 1 – 146
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: 1. The special incentive arrangement for sustainable development and good governance shall be withdrawn temporarily, in respect of all or of certain products originating in a GSP beneficiary country, where that country does not respect its binding undertakings as referred to in Article 9, points (d), (e) and (f), with regard to the core human and labour rights. Non-compliance with other conventions listed in Annex VI, in particular those relating primarily to climate and environmental protection or governance, shall not in itself constitute a sufficient ground for temporary withdrawal.
